A total of 42 athletics events were contested, 21 for men and 21 for women.  The men's 10,000 metres and women's 5000 metres were dropped from the programme for this edition.

1988 Arab Junior Athletics Championships | The 1988 Arab Junior Athletics Championships was the third edition of the international athletics competition for under-20 athletes from Arab countries.  It took place in Damascus, Syria – the first time the event was staged in West Asia.  A total of 41 athletics events were contested, 23 for men and 18 for women.
